name: Tomayto Tomahto
source:
Something is wrong with Tomàs, you know it, you feel it and you don't want to get rid of it. 

Tomayto Tomahto is about a toxic couple who's issue worsen while they pretend they never killed anyone.

[From [url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/tomayto-tomahto]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
托马斯身上有些不对劲——你心知肚明，你也亲身感受得到，而你根本不想摆脱这一切。

《半斤八两》（Tomayto Tomahto）讲述了一对病态情侣的故事：两人一边假装自己从未杀过人，一边任由彼此之间的问题愈演愈烈。

[摘自[url=https://dreamty-dream.itch.io/tomayto-tomahto]itch.io[/url]]
